missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Дно' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Реки' is the genitive of possession, and 'покрыто' is the neuter short form agreeing with дно.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Дно' is the accusative after 'на', marking the destination of downward motion. 'Ныряльщик' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Дне' is the prepositional form after 'на', marking static location. 'Моря' is the genitive of possession, and 'лежит' shows resting position.
Strategic focus: Genitive after verb. 'Дна' is the genitive required by 'достиг', the verb of reaching. 'Океана' is a further genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Дна' is the genitive after 'со', marking the source of upward motion. 'Пузырьки' is the nominative plural subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Дну' is the dative after 'ко', marking the goal of movement. 'Озера' is the genitive of possession, and 'рыба' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Дно' is the accusative direct object of 'вижу', identical to the nominative for this neuter noun. 'Песчаное' agrees in the neuter accusative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Дном' is the instrumental after 'под', marking position beneath. 'Лодки' is the genitive of possession.
Strategic focus: Nominative with instrumental predicate. 'Дно' is the nominative subject, and 'было' agrees in the neuter past. 'Грязным' is the instrumental predicate adjective.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Днища' is the irregular nominative plural of дно as the subject. 'Прочные' agrees in the plural, and 'у старых бочек' is genitive of possession.
